post.title: Yard and Foundation Drainage Kenmore WA — French Drains, Downspout Tightlines, Grading and Where the Water Can Go
post.description: A Kenmore homeowner's guide to yard and foundation drainage: grading away from the house, French and curtain drains, downspout tightlines and catch basins, when Kenmore's land alteration and drainage rules apply, where the water is allowed to go, and how to vet a drainage contractor.
